purpose: Teach: 遠ざかっ/云え/たたく/ナニ/余る/ごちゃごちゃ/たてる/足る

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の影が遠ざかっていくのが見えた
lines.en: Riku — I watched your shadow getting farther away.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. Gaze following something already gone. The kind of quiet observation that catches him off-guard because she's being real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ちゃんと「サンキュー」って云えよ、桜
lines.style: Dry, slightly embarrassed. A little laugh underneath — teasing her back for being sentimental. Quick, like he's deflecting before it gets too sincere.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、机をたたくな
lines.en: Don't start banging on the desk again.
lines.style: Exasperated but not angry. A familiar complaint, delivered with the rhythm of someone who's said it before. Light — not a real scolding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ナニそれ?新しいゲーム?桜
lines.en: What is that? Some new game you're playing?
lines.style: Genuinely thrown. Eyebrows up. The question is real — he's actually trying to understand what she's doing. Warm curiosity underneath the surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の発想は余るほど豊かだな
lines.en: Your ideas just keep coming, don't they? Generous like that.
lines.style: Recognition without performance. Said like he's noticing something true about her. A pause before the compliment — not rushed. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、机の上、ごちゃごちゃで勉強できんのか、桜
lines.en: How do you even study with your desk like that? Total mess.
lines.style: Wry observation, said with the smallest smile. Not actually critical — just pointing out the obvious with affection. The tone of someone who knows her well enough to tease.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭でテントをたてる手伝いしろよ
lines.en: Help me set up the tent for the culture festival, yeah?
lines.style: Direct request wrapped in casual command. Not quite asking — assuming he'll do it. The confidence of someone who knows he's her person.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト点、これだけあれば足るだろ、桜
lines.en: Your test score — that's more than enough.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. A small affirming nod underneath the words. Not effusive — just steady reassurance. The kind of thing he means more than he shows.
